head: 61d57b2ee95b1f4216aad81f742f427d8bf64fc4
findings: EnvConfig synchronous string readers now parse a fresh environment provider per call. Synthetic set/change/delete controls observe each new value.

isCi reads an effect-provided ConfigProvider; isCiSync checks live Bun.env and a fresh synchronous provider. CI recognition is exact true, not 1 or TRUE. Provided configuration can intentionally disagree with the process environment.
Environment classification adds optional HOME and TURBO_CACHE_DIR. Synthetic directory inputs are trimmed; they do not independently establish remote eligibility or a protected namespace.

StepExec admission workload writing obtains a UUID through Effect Crypto and maps identity failure into AdmissionWorkloadRegistrationError. Existing temporary write/chmod/rename behavior remains; this is a random filesystem side effect outside task output purity.

Environment health and secret-session paths gain Crypto requirements. The existing health cache is process-local and keyed by repoRoot; .env reads and op subprocess probes remain effects, not pure configuration. No live secret operation was performed.

tests.command: bun run --cwd packages/tooling/tool/cli test test/shared-internals.test.ts test/turbo-cache.test.ts test/step-capture-lifecycle.test.ts

limits: The initial private control mistakenly treated optional cache directory fields as Options; it failed before results were retained. The corrected recipe uses optional string fields and passed.
This reviews two historical source deltas, not complete transitive process/environment behavior, production secret readiness, or signed remote qualification.
All 13 broader census obligations remain open.
